thread.title: Apple Jumps 4 Percent After Earnings Beat

author: Tom Lydon
title: Apple Jumps 4 Percent After Earnings Beat
text:
Shutterstock photo Apple ( AAPL ) shared a strong report for its third-quarter on Tuesday, beating analyst estimates on earnings per share and average iPhone selling price. The tech giant announced revenue of $53.3 billion and an EPS of $2.34, with both results beating analyst estimates of $52.3 billion and $2.18 per share, respectively, according to Thomson Reuters.
